judgement.reason: Monica is a Laravel web app on PostgreSQL/MySQL with optional search services, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is not too lenient.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares MEILISEARCH_URL in .env.example; TYPESENSE_HOST in .env.example. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not include the Meilisearch or Typesense settings or a scout driver setting that makes these search services optional, so the finding cannot be ruled out from the files shown.
